Search this TypeScript/Node codebase at /tmp/ruflo for redundant computations and code-level waste distinct from caching: duplicated work, recomputation, and ETL/parsing done more than once. EXCLUDE /node_modules, /.git, /dist, /tests, *.test.ts, *.spec.ts.

Find concretely:
1. THE SAME expensive computation performed multiple times in one code path (e.g. `JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(x))` deep-clone done twice; `Object.entries(this.map)` enumerated then `.entries()` again right after; a list filtered then the SAME list filtered again instead of chaining).
2. Deep-clone via `JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(...))` of large objects (slow + drops Dates/Maps/Sets/undefined) used when a shallow clone or structuredClone would do — and especially when the clone result is immediately only read.
3. `Array.from(map.entries())` / `[...map]` / `Object.keys(obj)` recomputed inside a loop whose body iterates over the SAME collection.
4. `.filter().map().reduce()` chains that could be a single `.reduce()` pass; multiple passes over the same array when one pass suffices.
5. Repeated regex / string normalization (sluggify, lowercase, trim) on a value that was just normalized one line up.
6. Same file/manifest parsed at multiple layers (e.g. plugin loader parses plugin.json, then the discovery layer reads & re-parses it, then the executor reads it again) — duplicated parses within ONE command run.
7. Whole-graph rebuilds instead of incremental updates (HNSW rebuild, dependency graph rebuild, agent topology rebuild on every change).
8. `JSON.stringify` used for equality/deep-equal checks repeatedly when a `WeakMap`/`Map` keyed by the relevant primitive would be O(1).
9. `structuredClone` of a structure that is only ever read fan-out to multiple consumers that mutate nothing.
10. Repeated `tsconfig`/`path.resolve` recomputation that could be hoisted to module scope.

Method: ripgrep then read.
  rg -n 'JSON\.parse\(JSON\.stringify' /tmp/ruflo/v3 -g '!node_modules' -g '!*.test.ts'
  rg -n 'structuredClone' /tmp/ruflo/v3 -g '!node_modules' -g '!*.test.ts'
  rg -n 'Object\.entries\(.*\)' /tmp/ruflo/v3 -g '!node_modules' -g '!*.test.ts'
  rg -n '\.filter\(.*\.map\(|\.map\(.*\.filter\(' /tmp/ruflo/v3
  rg -n 'rebuild|reindex|re-?compute|refresh' /tmp/ruflo/v3 -g '!node_modules' -g '!*.test.ts'

Hot files: the same large files the other reviewers are looking at — ruvector/*, memory/*, embeddings/*, cli commands, plugins/gastown-bridge/src/formula/executor.ts, plugins/gastown-bridge/src/index.ts, v3/@claude-flow/swarm/src/queen-coordinator.ts.

For each finding return: file path, line number(s), 6-12 line excerpt, what is duplicated/recomputed, why it's wasteful (extra pass / extra clone / re-parse), rough cost, and a concrete fix (single pass; hoist to module scope; shallow clone; reuse the already-parsed value; incrementally update instead of rebuild). 6-12 findings. Verify excerpts against actual files — do not guess.
